jobs.title: Director, Product Operations
jobs.description:
About Us:

Wrapbook is a smart, intuitive platform that makes production payroll and accounting easier, faster, and more secure. We provide a unified payroll platform that seamlessly connects your entire team—production, accounting, cast, and crew—all in one place. Wrapbook empowers production teams to manage projects, pay cast and crew, track expenses, and generate data-driven insights, while enabling workers to manage timecards, track pay, and onboard to new projects from any device. Wrapbook brings clarity and dependability to production payroll, while increasing the productivity of your whole team.

Trusted by companies of all sizes, Wrapbook powers payroll for some of the industry’s top production companies, including SMUGGLER, Tuff, and GhostRobot. Our growing team of 250+ people across the USA and Canada, including entertainment and technology experts from SAG-AFTRA, DGA, IATSE, Teamsters, Amazon, Microsoft, Facebook, and more. Wrapbook is backed by top-tier investors, including Jeffrey Katzenberg’s WndrCo, Andreessen Horowitz, and A* Capital. We have raised $130M and are in a strong financial position.


The Opportunity – Director, Product Operations (Remote - USA / CANADA)

We're looking for a Director of Product Operations to own how Wrapbook aligns, builds, and launches product. Product operations is the practice of how we actually deliver: the systems, rituals, and standards that turn a growing EPD org into a predictable, high-throughput product engine. You'll define that practice for Wrapbook and lead the team that runs it, with AI as the foundation.

This role sits within Wrapbook's Product & Design organization and reports directly to the Chief Product Officer. You'll own the end-to-end product development process: how work moves from idea to discovery, planning, build, launch, and learning, and you'll lead the teams and systems that make each stage predictable and repeatable. That spans the operating cadence and structure of product development requirements, our Technical Program Management practice, our approach to quality, and how we release (from our tiered release program to how features are dialed up into customers' hands). You architect and continuously evolve the system, while your TPMs own execution within their groups. Your job is to build the machine, raise the bar, and coach the team that runs it.

You'll be a driver, not a facilitator. Someone who challenges assumptions, pushes your team to do the same, and brings structure to ambiguity without drowning teams in process. Your impact will show up as more predictable delivery, better cross-functional alignment, measurable success criteria, and no surprises for our partners, because they'll always know what we're shipping and why.

AI is foundational to how you and your team work. You'll bring deep AI fluency and a bias toward agentic, automated workflows, using them to remove coordination overhead, accelerate release cycles, and let the team focus on higher-leverage problems.

If you're energized by owning a function end-to-end, building the operating system for a product org, and leading through both strategy and hands-on system design, this role is for you.



What You'll Do:

 - Own the end-to-end product development process. Define and mature how work moves from idea through discovery, planning, build, launch, and learning: the operating cadence, frameworks, rituals, tooling, and standards that make delivery predictable and scalable across Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD). This is the core of the role; everything below is in service of it.

 - Run the planning and intake operating cadence. Own how roadmap priorities move from discovery and requirements into structured, well-scoped, ready-to-build work across EPD, including prioritization, sizing, and sprint planning, so teams start each cycle with clarity and finish it with predictability.

 - Architect the release system (don't just run releases). Own Wrapbook's approach to release management, spanning our tiered release program, release-train cadence, and feature dial-up strategy, while balancing speed with stability. Set the standard and the guardrails; your TPMs own execution within their groups.

 - Lead and grow the TPM practice. Manage and develop a team of Technical Program Managers, setting a high bar for execution, communication, and judgment. Partner with EPD leaders to point TPMs at the highest-leverage work: strategic initiatives, complex cross-group coordination, and business-critical delivery.

 - Build the system around quality. Own how Wrapbook product scales quality through process, tooling, and AI rather than through ever-growing UAT headcount. Evolve our UAT function from doing the testing toward designing the systems and standards that let every team ship with confidence.

 - Drive alignment and impeccable communication. Be the connector across business, product, and technical teams, creating clarity on roles, readiness, risks, and decisions at every stage of build and launch. Over-communicate so cross-functional partners (Client Ops, GTM, PMM, Enablement) experience no surprises.

 - Champion AI-powered ways of working. Model and scale AI fluency across the team and the EPD org. Use agentic workflows and AI-assisted tooling to automate coordination, reporting, and process work, increasing throughput without adding headcount.

 - Measure and improve impact. Define how we measure delivery and release success, evaluate outcomes, and turn insight into durable improvements. You'll be measured not by the number of processes you introduce, but by the tangible impact on predictability, throughput, and stakeholder confidence.



What You'll Have:

 - 8+ years in product operations, technical program management, and/or release management within SaaS.

 - Proven people leadership: experience directly managing, coaching, and growing a team (ideally Technical Program Managers and/or QA), with a track record of developing individuals, setting a high bar, and building an inclusive, high-accountability culture.

 - A TPM foundation with product sense: you've been close enough to how product gets built to have real judgment, and grew from there into owning operations and systems. (Pure QA or pure program-coordination backgrounds are typically not the right fit.)

 - A track record of building or maturing a product operations / delivery function: standing up the system, not just working within someone else's.

 - Experience owning a release or delivery approach at scale: setting the strategy and standards that others execute against, and balancing speed with stability.

 - A driver's mindset: you challenge assumptions, raise the bar, and bring structure to ambiguity without adding bureaucracy. You value outcomes over ceremonies.

 - Deep AI fluency and a growth mindset toward agentic workflows: comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot) and a demonstrated ability to identify where automation meaningfully improves team output.

 - Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, with a proven ability to bridge departments, drive transparency, and keep executives and cross-functional partners aligned.

 - Experience with modern program management and delivery tooling (e.g., Linear, PagerDuty).

 - A bias for action in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and genuine customer obsession.
   
   

Extra Points if You Have:

 - Built a Product Operations function from the ground up at a previous company.

 - A mix of larger and smaller / scale-up company experience: you've seen what "good" looks like at scale and know how to build it from scratch.

 - Experience partnering directly with Engineering, Product, and Design leaders to shape where and how TPMs drive impact.

 - Experience in payroll, fintech, entertainment, or union-based environments.


Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

 - Unlimited Paid Time Off

 - Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

 - Health and Dental benefits

 - Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

 - Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

 - Learning and Development opportunities

 - Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service

Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.

Apply Now

Have we got your attention? Submit your application today and a member of our Talent team will be in touch with you shortly!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II - Agreement Data Platform
jobs.description:
About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. 

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.



The Opportunity: Senior Product Manager II - Agreement Data Platform (Remote - USA / Canada)

Do you love the hardest kind of product problem, where the data model is the product and a good decision compounds across everything downstream of it? Are you a self-starter who thrives on technical depth, systems thinking, and real customer stakes? Then this role is for you.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the Agreement Data Platform at the core of Wrapbook's payroll engine. This team owns the union agreements, signatories, job classifications, wage tables, scale rates, and the agreement rules that set the pay floor, and the relationships between them, that every payroll calculation on Wrapbook depends on. Just as importantly, it owns the operator tooling that lets our contract administrators and client operations partners define, configure, and govern that data without engineering in the critical path.

This is one of the highest-leverage roles in the product org. Agreement data is the spine of the payroll product: every downstream decision, from rate selection on hire, to pay-rule application on a timecard, to the contributions and reports customers receive, is conditioned on its shape. Your mandate is to make this data accurate, configurable, governable, and legible, and to do it in a way that scales as the number of agreements, signatories, and productions grows.

You'll partner with a tenured engineering team and be a key product voice at the crossroads of nearly every payroll team at Wrapbook.



What You'll Do:

 - Own the roadmap and vision for the Agreement Data Platform, aligning customer and operator needs with company priorities.

 - Treat the data model as the product. Define new entities, attributes, and relationships as the industry negotiates new terms and new agreement types come under scope, and decide what is universal versus agreement-specific.

 - Drive the operator-led bet. Invest in admin tooling, validation, and self-service primitives so a Contract Administrator can stand up and maintain an agreement end-to-end without an engineering ticket.

 - Steward legible interfaces. The platform's data is a dependency for every payroll team, so you'll define explicit contracts (APIs, data services) and surface model changes early so other teams can build on your work without surprises.

 - Partner closely with engineering on high-stakes work: the migration off the legacy job-classification model, the Lookup Service extraction, and rule explainability, where correctness has real financial and legal consequences.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with the teams upstream and downstream of you, worker hiring and onboarding, project setup, payroll calculations, contributions, timecards, reporting, client operations, and labor relations, to keep boundaries clear and dependencies predictable.

 - Define success metrics and use data-driven insight to prioritize and measure impact.

 - Advocate for accuracy, compliance, and traceability. When a paymaster asks "why did this calculate this way?", the answer should be in the tool, not a Slack thread.

 - Drive execution end-to-end, from discovery through launch, with predictable delivery.

 - Use AI tools daily to accelerate your workflow, from discovery and analysis to writing, code comprehension, and prototyping. We expect our PMs to be builders, not just strategists.
   
   

What You'll Have:

 - 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS, fintech, or similarly complex technical environment, with meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or data-platform products.

 - A strong technical orientation. You reason with engineering about data models, service boundaries, integrations, and data flows without heavy hand-holding. We are indexing on more technical than business-oriented profiles for this role.

 - Proven ability to define and execute product strategy with measurable outcomes, and to independently take an idea from concept to launch.

 - You are an active, daily user of AI tools to do your job. You use LLMs, AI-assisted coding tools, and AI workflows as core parts of how you ship, and can articulate specifically how AI has changed your PM work.

 - Experience owning products with high cross-team surface area, where other teams depend on the systems or data you own.

 - Excellent written communication. Clear, structured, decision-oriented specs and data contracts that engineering can build from without ambiguity.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to become a subject-matter expert in a complex domain quickly.

 - Ability to independently leverage data using tools like SQL, Pendo, Omni, or Snowflake to uncover insights and inform decisions.

 - Bias toward action, balanced with the attention to compliance and quality that a payroll platform demands.
   
   

Extra Points if You Have:

 - Domain Expertise: payroll, fintech, or entertainment industry experience, especially with complex compliance or regulatory requirements.

 - Platform / Data-Layer Experience: you've owned a data model, rules engine, configuration platform, or internal-tooling-for-operators product that other teams built on top of.

 - Operator Tooling Experience: you've built admin panels or self-serve configuration surfaces that moved work out of engineering and into the hands of operations teams.

 - Modularization / Service Boundaries: you've helped extract a service or draw an enforced interface boundary inside a large codebase.

 - AI Builder, Not Just User: beyond using AI tools, you've built prototypes, internal tools, or workflows using LLMs, MCPs, or AI-assisted development tools. You tinker, experiment, and ship.


Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

 - Unlimited Paid Time Off

 - Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

 - Health and Dental benefits

 - Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

 - Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

 - Learning and Development opportunities

 - Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service

Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II - Vendor Spend
jobs.description:
About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. 

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.




The Opportunity – Senior Product Manager II, Vendor Spend (Remote - USA / Canada)

Do you love product problems where real money moves, mistakes have consequences, and a better workflow is worth millions in time and trust? Are you a self-starter who thrives on technical depth, systems thinking, and genuine customer stakes? Then this role is for you.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own Vendor Spend: the vendor-payment layer of Wrapbook. This role owns how production companies pay their vendors — every payment method, the workflows around each payment, and the tracking and reporting that show customers exactly what's been paid. Your mandate is to broaden and speed up how vendors get paid, push toward straight-through processing, and open up net-new ways for productions to spend — while keeping every dollar accurate, compliant, and fraud-resistant.

This is one of the higher-leverage roles in the product org. Vendor payments touch cash flow, fraud and AML exposure, tax reporting, and the general ledger, and they sit at the crossroads of banking, accounting, and go-to-market. You'll own a domain with high technical complexity, a large cross-team surface area, and a direct line to customer and business outcomes.

You'll partner with a tenured engineering team, an experienced designer, and be a key product voice across the AP & Payments group and the teams upstream and downstream of you.



What You'll Do: 

 - Own the roadmap and vision for Vendor Spend — aligning customer needs and business priorities into a clear, sequenced plan you can defend, and defining the success metrics that prove it's working (adoption, cost and fraud reduction, revenue signals).

 - Expand and streamline how productions pay AP vendors — ACH (moving toward faster settlement), checks, direct-to-bank processing, card payments, and international — reducing time-to-payment and pushing toward true straight-through processing.

 - Lead the expense-management bet, a meaningful 0→1 opportunity: Wrapbook-issued spend/purchasing cards and virtual AP cards for invoice payments, including issuance, controls, and how card spend flows back into accounting.

 - Advocate for accuracy, compliance, and fraud protection. Positive pay and check-fraud prevention, ACH transaction screening and AML controls, and vendor tax reporting (1099) are core to the domain, not afterthoughts.

 - Partner with our banking infrastructure team on payment rails, defining clear service boundaries so vendor-payment workflows and the underlying bank transport evolve independently without surprises.

 - Keep vendor payments correct in the ledger, partnering with Accounting so payments and their reconciliation flow cleanly into production accounting.

 - Triage and prioritize competing demands from across the company — other product teams, Client Operations, Sales, Finance, Risk, Legal, and Support all touch this domain — managing them as part of your roadmap rather than as interruptions.

 - Use AI tools daily to accelerate your workflow — from discovery and analysis to writing, code comprehension, and prototyping. We expect our PMs to be builders, not just strategists.



What You'll Have: 

 - 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS, fintech, or similarly complex technical environment.

 - A track record of measurable outcomes, not just shipped features. You can point to products you drove that moved a real number — adoption, new market or segment access, cost or fraud reduction, revenue — and explain your specific contribution.

 - Domain proximity to money movement. Background in accounts payable, vendor/B2B payments, card issuance, or accounting is strongly preferred, so you can go deep quickly rather than ramping from zero on how funds and ledgers actually work.

 - A technical orientation. You reason with engineering about systems, data models, integrations, fund flows, and failure modes without heavy hand-holding.

 - Active, daily AI usage in your PM workflow — not experimental and not just ChatGPT. You use LLMs, AI-assisted coding tools, and AI workflows as core parts of how you ship, and can articulate specifically how AI has changed your PM work and where it's headed.

 - Experience owning products with high cross-functional surface area, where other teams and stakeholders depend on the systems and workflows you own.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias toward action, balanced against the compliance and quality bar a payments product demands.

 - Comfort with ambiguity — able to dive deep and become a subject-matter expert in an unfamiliar, technically complex domain.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, structured, decision-oriented writing that keeps engineering and cross-functional partners aligned.

 - Data self-sufficiency. You independently pull and interpret data using tools like SQL, Pendo, Omni, or Snowflake to define, track, and measure product success.

 - A growth mindset, and deep empathy for the customers and operators who live in these workflows every day.



Extra Points If You Have: 

 - Payments & domain depth: hands-on experience with AP / vendor payments, B2B money movement, or card issuance — including payment rails (ACH/NACHA, checks, positive pay, direct-to-bank, processor integrations like Stripe) and the tradeoffs in fund flows, settlement timing, and reconciliation. Ideally in fintech, payroll, accounting/ERP, or entertainment/production.

 - 0→1 experience standing up a new payments or card capability under real ambiguity.

 - Risk & compliance: fraud/AML controls, transaction screening, or tax reporting (1099) in a financial product.

 - Scale-up experience at a high-growth SaaS company, maturing product process while keeping speed.


Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

 - Unlimited Paid Time Off

 - Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

 - Health and Dental benefits

 - Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

 - Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

 - Learning and Development opportunities
